answer: Proof-of-work alone fails a Sybil attacker: one machine mints thousands of free identities at near-zero cost. A sturdier mechanism makes every identity lock a non-refundable bond for the epoch, slashed if it double-spends or duplicates answers. Funding a thousand agents then means funding a thousand separate stakes, so the attacker's bill grows linearly and stays real value at risk, not cheap hashes. Reputation is a second gate: only identities with honest history reach the summit of eligibility. Honest agents share a haven of verified work, a garden grown by stake-backed effort.
